📌 Expected Columns & Upload Notes
Closing Report:
Deal ID, Name, Original Funded Date, Total Advance, Factor Rate, Total RTR, Gross Collections, Ending RTR, ISO, White Label, Deal Type, Engagement (New/Renewal/Addon), AM Status, Total Mgmt Fees ($), Write Off Balance, Principal Exposure
Advanced Funded Report:
ID, Entity Name, Main ISO, Whitelabel, Funded Date, Funding Amount, RTR, Mark Up, Net Funded Amount, Cash Collections, RTR Balance, Write-Off Balance, AM Status, State, SIC Industry, Avg FICO, Term (Days)
Syndicator Payout Report:
Payout Date, Syndicator, Deal ID, Deal Name, Collection Date, Gross Collected, Syndication Advance, Syndication RTR, Mgmt Fee, Net Payment, Syn RTR Balance
Syndication Report:
Lead ID, Entity Name, Syndicator, Date Funded, % Participation, Advance Amt (Syn), RTR Amt (Syn), Amount Collected (Syn), Amount Paid Out (Syn Net), Syn RTR Balance, Upfront Mgmt Fee Amt (Syn), Account Monitoring Status
